name: Doki Doki Fallen Angel
source:
In an alternate universe where Monika is not self aware, our protagonist finds himself growing closer to Yuri. Soon however, he discovers what this girl is hiding from the outside world. The other girls problems start to appear as well, as they progress within the overarching narrative of Yuri and our protagonist's relationship. Fallen Angel is a story that is meant to tug and pull on many different emotions. It'll allow you to help Yuri overcome her self harm, anxiety, and insecurities. The story will swing from wholesome and heartfelt, to soul crushing sadness. With new artworks and music to help you lose yourself in the story and help create an experience you won't soon forget.Do you have what it takes to save... a Fallen Angel? 

[From [url=https://dokimods.me/mods/fallen-angel/]dokimods.me[/url]]
translation:
在莫妮卡没有自我意识的另一个宇宙中，我们的主角发现自己与尤里越来越接近。然而很快，他就发现了这个女孩向外界隐瞒的事情。随着尤里和主角关系的总体叙述的进展，其他女孩的问题也开始出现。《堕落天使》是一个旨在激发和拉动许多不同情感的故事。它会让你帮助尤里克服她的自残、焦虑和不安全感。这个故事将从健康和真挚的情感转向令人心碎的悲伤。新的艺术作品和音乐可以帮助你沉浸在故事中，并帮助创造一种你不会很快忘记的体验。你有能力拯救……堕落天使吗？
